title: Verified identities and explicit organization relationships
scope: Implement target constraints using Alembic and PostgreSQL.
Integrate existing OIDC issuer and session lifecycle; bootstrap first manager with privileged provisioning.
excluded: Organization authority inferred from names or domains
invariants: Issuer and subject identify a user; email is contact data.
Projects and grants use composite organization keys.
Only a privileged scoped platform workflow creates managers and staff assignments.

acceptance.given: One verified identity has memberships in organizations A and B
Two provider subjects share display email
acceptance.then: two identities remain distinct and no membership moves automatically

acceptance.given: A project from organization B is supplied under organization A
acceptance.when: an entitlement or report association is inserted
acceptance.then: the composite foreign key rejects it, even outside the HTTP layer

acceptance.given: Production is configured with the local test adapter
acceptance.then: startup refuses readiness; only tested OIDC integration enables the pilot

acceptance.given: A new organization is provisioned by the permitted platform identity
acceptance.then: the organization and audit changes roll back as one unit

acceptance.given: A normal access manager attempts to promote another manager
acceptance.then: the customer surface provides no such transition and the command is denied
